1.web: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
1.asv: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

2.web: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.
2.asv: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judah and his brethren;

3.web: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.
3.asv: and Judah begat Perez and Zerah of Tamar; and Perez begat Hezron; and Hezron begat Ram;

4.web: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.
4.asv: and Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon; and Nahshon begat Salmon;

5.web: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.
5.asv: and Salmon begat Boaz of Rahab; and Boaz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

6.web: Jesse became the father of King David. David became the father of Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah.
6.asv: and Jesse begat David the king. And David begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Uriah;

7.web: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.
7.asv: and Solomon begat Rehoboam; and Rehoboam begat Abijah; and Abijah begat Asa;

8.web: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.
8.asv: and Asa begat Jehoshaphat; and Jehoshaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Uzziah;

9.web: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.
9.asv: and Uzziah begat Jotham; and Jotham begat Ahaz; and Ahaz begat Hezekiah;

10.web: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.
10.asv: and Hezekiah begat Manasseh; and Manasseh begat Amon; and Amon begat Josiah;

11.web: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the exile to Babylon.
11.asv: and Josiah begat Jechoniah and his brethren, at the time of the carrying away to Babylon.

12.web: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.
12.asv: And after the carrying away to Babylon, Jechoniah begat Shealtiel; and Shealtiel begat Zerubbabel;

13.web: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.
13.asv: and Zerubbabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

14.web: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.
14.asv: and Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

15.web: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.
15.asv: and Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

16.web: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
16.asv: and Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

17.web: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.
17.asv: So all the generations from Abraham unto David are fourteen generations; and from David unto the carrying away to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon unto the Christ fourteen generations.

18.web: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this; for after his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
18.asv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found with child of the Holy Spirit.

19.web: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
19.asv: And Joseph her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.

20.web: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary, your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
20.asv: But when he thought on these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

21.web: She shall give birth to a son. You shall call his name Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”
21.asv: And she shall bring forth a son; and thou shalt call his name JESUS; for it is he that shall save his people from their sins.

22.web: Now all this has happened, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
22.asv: Now all this is come to pass, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

23.web: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel”; which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”
23.asv: Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, And they shall call his name Immanuel; which is, being interpreted, God with us.

24.web: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;
24.asv: And Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took unto him his wife;

25.web: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.
25.asv: and knew her not till she had brought forth a son: and he called his name JESUS.
